commits.message:
New version

* Updated to use 1000hz instead of 300hz.
* Changed to use performance governor by default instead of ondemand.

Modify package to make it check for existence of the symlink as it was creating a symlink
inside the symlinked dir.
Update the logo to the new one.

Implemented stupid workaround for Ryan's stupid code that stops
ATLauncher from obeying CWD.
ATLauncher changed from using Creative Commons to GPL License, updated package to reflect this.

Major improvements to the package to make it's directory permissions more secure while still sharing a Downloads directory.

Also automatic updating of the pkgver and downloads the latest jar file from the ATLauncher site.
Added in the rest of the files.
Updated package and added readme about aur4.
Added a README.md which describes each of the files.
Added pacgen submodule again and updated pacgen report.
Updated OpenBlocks config to make elevator not drain XP.
Sorted change log please update it as you go along in future.
Removed DungeonPack as it generates dungeons in stupid places.
Removed something that should not have been there.borts the commit.

Revert "Removed MCPC."

This reverts commit 3ec45791f83a9b37f49889899a272c14a576cb50.
